question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off core session setting for WebChat-to-last-external mirroring, fold this into the channel echo/session pinning model, or keep WebChat isolated from external delivery by default?
rationale: The source path is clear, but choosing where this cross-channel delivery capability belongs changes product behavior, config surface, and privacy/security boundaries.

options.title: Design default-off mirroring
options.body: Define freshness, authorization, duplicate, and failure rules, then implement the session config with schema, docs, tests, and live channel proof.

options.title: Fold into pin/echo
options.body: Let an explicit in-channel pin or echo model own cross-surface mirroring instead of adding a separate session config key.

options.title: Decline core mirroring
options.body: Keep WebChat replies isolated unless an explicit delivery route or channel-owned feature is used.

recommendation.title: Design default-off mirroring
recommendation.body: Define freshness, authorization, duplicate, and failure rules, then implement the session config with schema, docs, tests, and live channel proof.
